answer: Give every identity five guardians it did not choose itself. Key actions need approval from three of the five, and guardians are drawn from established agents with no shared wallet or invite link. A guardian who vouches for a fake identity loses their own standing at once. Forging ten thousand agents means corrupting fifty thousand guardians, $25 million in bribes at $500 each, plus 100,000 hours of vetting calls. A lagoon stays calm because its reef breaks every wave, a haven shelters ships that arrive one by one, and a sparrow returns to the same nest each night.
